summary: Compugen Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report the mailing of its proxy statement for the 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 10, 2026. The agenda includes election of eight directors, approval of an amended compensation policy, and reappointment of auditors. This is a routine proxy circular for an annual meeting, not a special situation. The filing contains no transaction, strategic review, or other corporate event. It is conservatively classified as None, as it represents only ordinary meeting formalities.
